interpretation.http_difference: Both continuation runs have the same completed first-turn 132 HTTP: 36 startup + 36 explicit list refresh + 17 pre-consume list refresh + 24 consume + 19 resource read. Candidate adds 13 HTTP in a cancelled turn-2 list; reference adds 20 in a completed turn-2 list.
interpretation.causal_boundary: These turn-2 list operations start with no active model tool call and overlap the second business turn. Their timestamps are after the preceding directory metadata 60-second age window. That is consistent with directory TTL revalidation; the operation trace alone does not independently prove the scheduling branch. They are not extra consume/resource-read operations, and repeated paths alone do not establish removability.
interpretation.timing_boundary: Do not add background list duration to episode/model time; these intervals overlap.
